title: Nicodemus’ encounter with Jesus Christ
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells John 3:1-5: Nicodemus, a Pharisee, comes at night, Jesus says one must be born again, of water and the Spirit; says what John 3:16 promises; and says why baptism matters to Christians (a sign of turning to God and new life), without asking how it is done.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the Holy Spirit helps Christians.
floor.question: Name one thing the Holy Spirit does for a Christian.

representations: a night scene with a lamp
steps: Who was Nicodemus and when did he come?
What did Jesus say about being born again?
contexts: a child with honest questions about God
a family reading John 3:16 at home

board.do: Draw a lamp in the dark and write "born again".

board.say: Did Jesus mean born again from a mother?

board.do: Wait for the child to say no, a new life from God.

listen_for: At noon, in front of everyone
misconceptions.ask: When did Nicodemus come to Jesus?

listen_for: To be born a second time from one's mother
misconceptions.ask: What did Jesus mean by "born again"?
Whom does God love, according to John 3:16?

listen_for: It is only a nice ceremony with water
misconceptions.ask: Why is baptism important to Christians today?
misconceptions.repair: Link John 3:5 with Acts 2:38: repent and be baptised. Baptism marks a new life; ask what changes after.

checks.question: When did Nicodemus come to Jesus?
Why is baptism important to Christians?
checks.answer: It shows turning to God and a new life
